svg.title: One create_agent run, step by step
svg.desc: Five lifelines under small drawings: your code as a terminal, the model node, the chat model, the tools node, and the checkpointer as a cylinder. A sixth column shows the messages in each checkpoint as chips. Six numbered steps, which match the list in the text: 1, the input checkpoint at step -1 with no messages and next __start__. 2, the checkpoint at step 0 with the human message and next model. 3, the model node calls the chat model with the system prompt "You add numbers." and the human message, gets a tool call add with 2 and 3, and saves step 1 with next tools. 4, the model node sends the tool call to the tools node, which saves step 2 with the ToolMessage for call_1 and next model. 5, the second model call gets 4 messages and answers "The sum is 5.". 6, the checkpoint at step 3 has 4 messages and no next node, and invoke returns them.
